package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"google.golang.org/grpc"

	"github.com/qwq-panel/qwq/sdk/manifest"
	"github.com/qwq-panel/qwq/sdk/pluginsdk"
)

// TestXrayPackageIdentity 在打包 overlay 下验证实际嵌入描述符。
func TestXrayPackageIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	expected := os.Getenv("QWQ_XRAY_BUILD_EXPECT_VERSION")
	if expected == "" {
		t.Fatal("打包版本缺失")
	}
	document, err := manifest.Parse(Manifest())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if document.Version != expected {
		t.Fatalf("嵌入版本 %s，期望 %s", document.Version, expected)
	}
	registrar := grpc.NewServer()
	defer registrar.Stop()
	server, err := pluginsdk.Serve(t.Context(), pluginsdk.Options{Plugin: New(), Manifest: Manifest(), Registrar: registrar})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer server.Close()
	if got := server.Descriptor().GetPluginVersion(); got != expected {
		t.Fatalf("RPC 描述符版本 %s，期望 %s", got, expected)
	}
	readServer, _ := fakeReadServer(t, &fakeRuntimeSource{}, nil)
	response := readInvoke(t, readServer, "core.capabilities", "{}")
	if response.GetError() != nil {
		t.Fatal("能力接口身份读取失败")
	}
	var capabilities capabilitiesResult
	if json.Unmarshal(response.GetPayloadJson(), &capabilities) != nil || capabilities.DriverVersion != expected {
		t.Fatal("能力接口版本与实际包身份不一致")
	}
}
